<div class="row__col-md--8 col-left"><div class="field-content"><h2>Council meetings</h2>
<p>In accordance with the <em>Local Government Act 1995</em>, the City of Perth Council meets regularly to make decisions concerning the City of Perth. The decision-making meetings are Ordinary and Special Council Meetings where Councillors debate and vote on the matters contained within the agenda for that meeting. The decisions made at these meetings are implemented by the City’s Administration.</p>
<p>Council meetings are chaired by the Lord Mayor* and are guided by the Standing Orders Local Law 2009, which details the requirements for meeting facilitation, order of business and adherence to statutory requirements.</p>
<p>City of Perth Ordinary Council Meetings are open to the public and commence at 5.00pm on the last Tuesday of the month, except the December Ordinary Council meeting which is held on the second Tuesday of the month. The meetings are held in the Council Chamber, Level 9, Council House, 27 St Georges Terrace, Perth.</p>
<p>The public is able to attend and ask questions during Public Question Time. When confidential information needs to be considered, parts of the meeting may be closed to the public.</p>
<p style="margin-left: 40px;"><em>* If the Lord Mayor is absent, the Deputy Lord Mayor will preside over Ordinary Council Meetings. </em></p>
<p style="margin-left: 40px;"><em>If both the Lord Mayor and Deputy Lord Mayor are absent, the elected member appointed by Council under section 5.35(1) of the Local Government Act 1995 will preside.</em></p>
<p style="margin-left: 40px;"><em>If that appointed member is also unavailable, Council will decide who will preside over the meeting.</em></p>
<h2>Agenda Briefing Sessions</h2>
<p>
The purpose of Agenda Briefing Sessions is for Councillors to ask questions and obtain additional information in respect to items presented on the draft Ordinary Council Meeting agenda. Questions asked by Councillors are to be answered by the CEO or a person nominated by the CEO. No decisions are made at Agenda Briefing Sessions.</p>
<p>The Sessions are held at 5.00pm on the Tuesday prior to the Ordinary Council Meeting and are open to members of the public. Members of the public in attendance can make deputations on items of interest on the agenda. When confidential information needs to be considered, parts of the meeting may be closed to the public.</p>
<p>Further information can be found in the <a href="/-/media/Project/COP/COP/COP/Documents-and-Forms/Council/Documents/Our-Committees/Committees-Sessions-and-External-Bodies-Register--as-at-17-September-2026.pdf">Committee, Session and External Bodies Register</a>.</p>
<h2>Public participation</h2>
<p>
The public is able to participate in meetings in primarily two ways:</p>
<ul>
    <li>Public Question Time (Ordinary Council Meetings, Special Council Meetings and Committee Meetings) – to ask a question, <a href="/forms-and-payments/council-and-citizenship/public-question-time-request-submission">click here</a>. </li>
    <li>Deputations (Agenda Briefing Sessions, Committee Meetings and Special Council Meetings) - to submit a deputation request, <a href="/forms-and-payments/council-and-citizenship/deputation-request-submission">click here</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p><em>In the event of difficulties submitting your question/deputation, please forward to <a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#bfd8d0c9dacdd1ded1dcdaffdcd6cbc6d0d9cfdacdcbd791c8de91d8d0c991deca"><span class="__cf_email__" data-cfemail="f3949c8596819d929d9096b3909a878a9c95839681879bdd8492dd949c85dd9286">[email protected]</span></a></em></p>
<p> </p></div>

<p>The City of Perth acknowledges the Traditional Custodians of the Land we are situated on, the Whadjuk people of the Nyoongar nation and Aboriginal people from other Lands.</p>
<p>We celebrate the continuing traditions, living culture, and the spiritual connection to Boorloo (Perth) and the Derbarl Yerrigan (Swan River).</p>
<p>We offer our respects to Elders past and present.</p>
<br />
<h2>Cultural Sensitivity Warning</h2>
<p>Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people are respectfully advised that this website contains names, images, voices and videos of deceased persons.</p>        </div>

<h2>Acknowledgement of Country</h2>
<p>The City of Perth acknowledges the Traditional Custodians of the Land we are situated on, the Whadjuk people of the Nyoongar nation and Aboriginal people from other Lands.</p>
<p>We celebrate the continuing traditions, living culture, and the spiritual connection to Boorloo (Perth) and the Derbarl Yerrigan (Swan River).</p>
<p>We offer our respects to Elders past and present.</p>
<br />
<h2>Cultural Sensitivity Warning</h2>
<p>Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people are respectfully advised that this website contains names, images, voices and videos of deceased persons.</p>        </div>

<h2>Acknowledgement of Country</h2>
<p>The City of Perth acknowledges the Traditional Custodians of the Land we are situated on, the Whadjuk people of the Nyoongar nation and Aboriginal people from other Lands.</p>
<p>We celebrate the continuing traditions, living culture, and the spiritual connection to Boorloo (Perth) and the Derbarl Yerrigan (Swan River).</p>
<p>We offer our respects to Elders past and present.</p>

<h2>Cultural Sensitivity Warning</h2>
<p>Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people are respectfully advised that this website contains names, images, voices and videos of deceased persons.</p>        </div>

<p>We celebrate the continuing traditions, living culture, and the spiritual connection to Boorloo (Perth) and the Derbarl Yerrigan (Swan River).</p>
<p>We offer our respects to Elders past and present.</p>

<h2>Acknowledgement of Country</h2>
<p>The City of Perth acknowledges the Traditional Custodians of the Land we are situated on, the Whadjuk people of the Nyoongar nation and Aboriginal people from other Lands.</p>
<p>We celebrate the continuing traditions, living culture, and the spiritual connection to Boorloo (Perth) and the Derbarl Yerrigan (Swan River).</p>
<p>We offer our respects to Elders past and present.</p>
<br />
<h2>Cultural Sensitivity Warning</h2>
<p>Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people are respectfully advised that this website contains names, images, voices and videos of deceased persons.</p>        </div>

<p>We celebrate the continuing traditions, living culture, and the spiritual connection to Boorloo (Perth) and the Derbarl Yerrigan (Swan River).</p>
<p>We offer our respects to Elders past and present.</p>

<h2>Acknowledgement of Country</h2>
<p>The City of Perth acknowledges the Traditional Custodians of the Land we are situated on, the Whadjuk people of the Nyoongar nation and Aboriginal people from other Lands.</p>
<p>We celebrate the continuing traditions, living culture, and the spiritual connection to Boorloo (Perth) and the Derbarl Yerrigan (Swan River).</p>
<p>We offer our respects to Elders past and present.</p>

<div class="meeting-wrapper"><div class="meeting-detail-content"><h1 class="field-title">Annual Electors General Meeting</h1><div class="field-content"><p><strong><em>*Please note the update to the location for this meeting</em></strong></p>
<p>The City of Perth Annual Electors General Meeting will be held at Council House, 27 St Georges Terrace, Perth on Tuesday, 27 January 2026.</p>
<p>The meeting will be held in the Reception Room commencing at 5.00pm. Ratepayers and other City stakeholders are invited to attend.</p>
<p><strong>This meeting will be live streamed - <a href="/council/livestream">click here</a> to access the stream.</strong></p>
<p>The purpose of the meeting is to receive the City’s:</p>
<ul>
    <li>2024/25 Annual Report;</li>
    <li>Financial Statements for the year ended 30 June 2025; and</li>
    <li>Auditors Report</li>
</ul>
<p>If an Elector wishes to raise a question or move a motion at the Electors General Meeting, please complete an Annual Electors General Meeting Registration and Motion/Question Form and submit to <a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#20"><span class="__cf_email__" data-cfemail="c7a0a8b1a2b5a9a6a9a4a287a4aeb3bea8a1b7a2b5b3afe9b0a6e9a0a8b1e9a6b2">[email protected]</span></a> 24 hours prior to the meeting.</p>
<p>The City’s 2024-25 Annual Report is available on the City’s website here <a href="https://perth.wa.gov.au/council/reports-and-important-documents">https://perth.wa.gov.au/council/reports-and-important-documents</a> and in the minutes of the Ordinary Council Meeting held on 9 December 2025: <a href="/council/council-meetings/ordinary-council-meeting-9-dec-2025">https://perth.wa.gov.au/council/council-meetings/ordinary-council-meeting-9-dec-2025</a> </p>
<p>For further information please contact Charlie Clarke, Alliance Manager Council Governance and Policy on 08 9461 3212.</p>
<h2>Electors’ General Meeting Procedure </h2>
<p>In accordance with clause 5.30 of the Local Government Act 1995, the Lord Mayor is to preside at an Electors’ General Meeting <br />
<br />
Regulation 18 of the Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996 states that the procedure to be followed at an Electors’ General Meeting is to be determined by the person presiding at the meeting.  <br />
<br />
The following procedure is provided for guidance only and the final procedure will be determined by the Lord Mayor at the meeting.  </p>
<ol>
    <li>All present are required to sign the attendance register upon entry to the meeting, including name and address. </li>
    <li>Speakers must be electors of the City of Perth. </li>
    <li>The proceedings will be recorded for the purpose of production of minutes, and speakers are requested to use the microphone when speaking. </li>
    <li>No other audio-visual recordings are to be undertaken without permission from the Lord Mayor. </li>
    <li>The order of proceedings will firstly be reference to these rules by the Lord Mayor followed by: 
    <ol>
        <li>Declaration of opening and welcome</li>
        <li>Acknowledgement of Elected Members in Attendance</li>
        <li>Lord Mayor’s message</li>
        <li>2024-25 Annual Report, Financial Statements and Auditor’s Report</li>
        <li>General business</li>
        <li>Closure</li>
    </ol>
    </li>
    <li>During general business, questions and motions may only relate to the matters that affect the local government and will be accepted at the discretion of the Lord Mayor. </li>
    <li>Deputations or statements will not be permitted. </li>
</ol>
<h3>Electors proposing motions or questions to the meeting </h3>
<ol>
    <li>Proposed motions and questions must be submitted no later than 24 hours prior to the meeting. Forms are available on the <a href="/council/council-meetings">City’s website </a></li>
    <li>Only motions and questions for which the City has received 24 hours’ notice will be addressed at the meeting. </li>
    <li>The Lord Mayor will call for a mover and seconder for a motion. </li>
    <li>No motion is open to debate until it has been seconded. Only one motion will be received at a time.</li>
    <li>Upon a motion being proposed, the Lord Mayor may call for speakers to address the meeting. </li>
    <li>When addressing the meeting, a speaker is to: 
    <ol>
        <li>Move to the lectern (unless otherwise instructed, or unable to do so due to sickness or a disability) </li>
        <li>State their name and suburb</li>
        <li>Address the meeting through the Lord Mayor </li>
        <li>Limit any questions to fact, not opinion or supposition </li>
    </ol>
    </li>
    <li>The mover of a motion has the right of reply and closes the debate. </li>
</ol>
<h3>Voting at the meeting </h3>
<ol>
    <li>Once a motion has been moved and seconded, the Lord Mayor will ask for a vote on the motion from the electors. </li>
    <li>Each elector has one vote. An elector is not required to vote. </li>
    <li>Voting is determined by a show of hands. </li>
    <li>A simple majority carries the vote. </li>
</ol>
<h3>Decisions made at the meeting </h3>
<ol>
    <li>The decisions of this meeting are not binding on the City of Perth Council. All decisions made at the meeting will be presented to Council for its consideration at its next practicable meeting. </li>
    <li>Minutes of this meeting will be available on the City’s website as soon as practicable after the meeting and before the next Ordinary Council meeting. </li>
</ol></div><div style="display:none;">{DF0353D6-ECE2-4E8B-9213-EBDE89237376}</div><h3 class="field-meetingtype"></h3><div><div class="field-sessiontitle"></div></div></div><div class="meeting-detail-list"><div class="meeting-details"><div class="field-meetingdate"><span>Date</span>27 Jan 26</div><div class="field-meetingdate"><span>Time</span>05:00PM</div><div class="field-location field-meetinglocation"><span>Location</span>Level 11, Reception Room</div><div class="field-opentopublic"><span>Open to public?</span>Yes</div></div><div class="resource-links document-list resource-links-wrapper"><h2>Documents</h2><ul><li class="list-item"><a title="Agenda - <div class="meeting-wrapper"><div class="meeting-detail-content"><h1 class="field-title">Ordinary Council Meeting</h1><div class="field-content"><p>The Ordinary Council Meeting of 24 February 2026 was adjourned and will recommence at <strong>4.00pm on Wednesday 25 February 2026</strong>.</p>
<p>The remainder of the meeting will be open for members of the public to attend in person (excluding any confidential items) and livestreamed on the <a href="/council/livestream">City’s You Tube channel</a>.</p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Statement regarding the Minutes:</strong></p>
<p><span style="color: black;">In respect of Items 17.6 and 20.1 of the Minutes, the following clarification is provided with regard to the Conflict of Interest Declaration by Deputy Lord Mayor Goncalves:</span></p>
<p><span style="color: black;">On 26 February 2026, the WorkSafe Commissioner advised the City that WorkSafe does not have any investigation open in relation to the City of Perth and the Commissioner is not aware of any communications to the contrary to any other person. </span></p></div><div style="display:none;">{17C7ABF0-CD69-4716-AF76-9FFFACB3FEC5}</div><h3 class="field-meetingtype"></h3><div><div class="field-sessiontitle"></div></div></div><div class="meeting-detail-list"><div class="meeting-details"><div class="field-meetingdate"><span>Date</span>24 Feb 26</div><div class="field-meetingdate"><span>Time</span>05:00PM</div><div class="field-location field-meetinglocation"><span>Location</span>City of Perth Council Chamber Council House</div><div class="field-opentopublic"><span>Open to public?</span>Yes</div></div><div class="resource-links document-list resource-links-wrapper"><h2>Documents</h2><ul><li class="list-item"><a title="Agenda - <div class="meeting-wrapper"><div class="meeting-detail-content"><h1 class="field-title">Special Council Meeting</h1><div class="field-content"><p>In accordance with Section 5.5(2) of the <em>Local Government Act 1995</em> and Regulation 12(4) of the <em>Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996</em>, notice is given that a Special Council Meeting has been called for Tuesday, 19 May 2026 commencing at 7:30pm in Committee Room 1 at Council House, Level 9, 27 St Georges Terrace, Perth.<br />
<br />

<div class="meeting-wrapper"><div class="meeting-detail-content"><h1 class="field-title">Special Council Meeting</h1><div class="field-content"><p>This Special Council Meeting has been called for the purpose of considering a confidential matter. Following the declaration of opening and completion of procedural matters, the meeting will be closed to members of the public pursuant to section 5.23 of the <em>Local Government Act 1995</em>.</p>
<p>In accordance with Section 5.5(2) of the <em>Local Government Act 1995</em> and Regulation 12(4) of the <em>Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996</em>, notice is given that a Special Council Meeting has been called for Tuesday 22 September 2026, commencing at 6:45pm in Committee Room 1 at Council House, Level 9, 27 St Georges Terrace, Perth.</p>
<p>This Special Council Meeting has been called for the purpose of considering a confidential matter.</p></div><div style="display:none;">{A3C28A7A-5DE5-462C-B633-01A43D528D41}</div><h3 class="field-meetingtype"></h3><div><div class="field-sessiontitle"></div></div></div><div class="meeting-detail-list"><div class="meeting-details"><div class="field-meetingdate"><span>Date</span>22 Sep 26</div><div class="field-meetingdate"><span>Time</span>06:45PM</div><div class="field-location field-meetinglocation"><span>Location</span>Committee Room 1, Council House</div><div class="field-opentopublic"><span>Open to public?</span>Yes</div></div><div class="resource-links document-list resource-links-wrapper"><h2>Documents</h2><ul><li class="list-item"><a title="Public Agenda- SCM - 22 September  2026" href="/-/media/Project/COP/COP/COP/Documents-and-Forms/Council/Documents/Council-Meetings/Agendas-and-minutes/2026/09---September/Public-Agenda--SCM---22-September--2026.pdf" download="">Agenda</a><span class="document-list__icon"></span><span class="article-detail-list-filesize"><span class="field-size"><span>179.55 KB</span><span>  | </span></span><span>PDF Document</span></span></li><li class="list-item"><a title="Minutes - For Publishing" href="/-/media/Project/COP/COP/COP/Documents-and-Forms/Council/Documents/Council-Meetings/Agendas-and-minutes/2026/09---September/Minutes---For-Publishing.pdf" download="">Minutes</a><span class="document-list__icon"></span><span class="article-detail-list-filesize"><span class="field-size"><span>204.42 KB</span><span>  | </span></span><span>PDF Document</span></span></li></ul></div></div></div>    </div>

<div class="meeting-wrapper"><div class="meeting-detail-content"><h1 class="field-title">Special Council Meeting</h1><div class="field-content"><p>In accordance with Section 5.5(2) of the <em>Local Government Act 1995</em> and Regulation 12(4) of the <em>Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996</em>, notice is given that a Special Council Meeting has been called for Tuesday 13 October 2026, commencing at 6:15pm in Committee Room 1 at Council House, Level 9, 27 St Georges Terrace, Perth.</p>
<p>This Special Council Meeting has been called for the purpose of considering Chief Executive Officer arrangements.</p>
<p><em>When confidential business is to be considered, the meeting will be closed to members of the public pursuant to section 5.23 of the Local Government Act 1995.</em></p></div><div style="display:none;">{094E318A-7BA7-4C4C-A97E-074FEE10F5C6}</div><h3 class="field-meetingtype"></h3><div><div class="field-sessiontitle"></div></div></div><div class="meeting-detail-list"><div class="meeting-details"><div class="field-meetingdate"><span>Date</span>13 Oct 26</div><div class="field-meetingdate"><span>Time</span>06:15PM</div><div class="field-location field-meetinglocation"><span>Location</span>Committee Room 1, Council House</div><div class="field-opentopublic"><span>Open to public?</span>Yes</div></div><div class="resource-links document-list resource-links-wrapper"><h2>Documents</h2><ul><li class="list-item"><a title="Public Agenda - SCM - 13 October 2026" href="/-/media/Project/COP/COP/COP/Documents-and-Forms/Council/Documents/Council-Meetings/Agendas-and-minutes/2026/10---October/Public-Agenda---SCM---13-October-2026.pdf" download="">Agenda</a><span class="document-list__icon"></span><span class="article-detail-list-filesize"><span class="field-size"><span>191.29 KB</span><span>  | </span></span><span>PDF Document</span></span></li><li class="list-item"><a title="Minutes - SCM - 13 October 2026 v1" href="/-/media/Project/COP/COP/COP/Documents-and-Forms/Council/Documents/Council-Meetings/Agendas-and-minutes/2026/10---October/Minutes---SCM---13-October-2026-v1.pdf" download="">Minutes</a><span class="document-list__icon"></span><span class="article-detail-list-filesize"><span class="field-size"><span>243.55 KB</span><span>  | </span></span><span>PDF Document</span></span></li></ul></div></div></div>    </div>
